run_benchplot_cli: run the benchplot script with a re2 benchlog file to generate a PNG plot
parse_re2_benchlog: parse a re2 benchlog file into a dictionary of benchmark data grouped by test name
gen_csv_tempfiles: generate temporary semicolon-delimited CSV files from parsed benchlog data for gnuplot input
run_gnuplot_plot: run gnuplot via subprocess to render a PNG chart from benchlog CSV data
review_gnuplot_class: review the gnuplot class context manager that cleans up temporary files on exit
